rows.grounds: compound napuṃsaka-upalena; instrumental of the material used
compound mūrdhan-iṣṭakā; object to be placed

items.question: What type of stone is prescribed for placing the crowning brick?
premises: The crowning brick is the object to be placed.
A neuter-gendered stone is specified as the material.
The instruction is addressed to the best of the twice-born.
items.inference: The crowning brick must be placed using a neuter-gendered stone.
uncertainties: The ritual basis for classifying stones as neuter-gendered is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: O best of the twice-born, one should place the crowning brick with a neuter stone indeed.
